answer: To bind a WebAuthn passkey to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The jade of the check is the signature itself; a velvet in the response invalidates the claim, and a onyx of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a WebAuthn passkey to multiply identities.
